project_name: MME Private Limited - Header CTA & Careers Application Redesign
theme: Light & Industrial Dark Fusion (Preserving Navy #0a1a2f, Gold #c8a25c, Slate #f5f4f1, White #ffffff)

typography.font_family_body: DM Sans / Instrument Sans / Inter (body only)

entry_surfaces./: industrial brand hero slider with gold accents and sticky glass nav
entry_surfaces./careers: split/layered careers page — hero introduction, open positions grid, and prominent two-column formal career application form with resume and photo uploads
entry_surfaces./contact: corporate inquiry and quote request form with branch locations

header_cta_change.rule: Do NOT remove company logo from header or footer. Remove ONLY the mobile phone number (+91-120-3664152) from the desktop header navigation bar and replace it with a prominent gold quote button.
header_cta_change.button_styling: bg-[#c8a25c] hover:bg-[#d9b877] text-[#0a1a2f] font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider px-5 py-2.5 rounded-sm shadow-md transition-all hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98] inline-flex items-center gap-2

careers_page_and_form_redesign.rule: Replace the minimal 'Quick apply' (name + email only) with the comprehensive two-column 'Career Application Form' as per the user's reference design. In addition, 'Role' must be a text input field (NOT a dropdown/select).
careers_page_and_form_redesign.layout: Clean, spacious two-column desktop responsive grid with clear visual field groupings, dedicated file upload dropzones for Resume and Photo, and a centered 'Submit Application' gold CTA button.

form_fields.label: Role
form_fields.placeholder: e.g. Senior Mechanical Engineer / Site Supervisor / Project Manager
form_fields.note: Must be free-text input as explicitly specified by user

form_fields.label: Highest Qualification
form_fields.placeholder: e.g. B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering

submit_button.label: Submit Application
submit_button.styling: w-full sm:w-auto min-w-[240px] px-8 py-4 bg-[#c8a25c] hover:bg-[#d9b877] text-[#0a1a2f] font-bold text-base uppercase tracking-wider rounded-sm shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 flex items-center justify-center gap-3 cursor-pointer

backend_and_email_notification.storage: Store application payload in MongoDB 'career_applications' collection with timestamp and status 'received'
backend_and_email_notification.email_behavior: Send single internal HR notification email to info@mmepl.co.in or configured HR email. Do NOT send applicant auto-reply (as per user clarification). Use dummy SMTP credentials / mocked SMTP service if not configured so submission always succeeds cleanly without crashes.
backend_and_email_notification.feedback: Show toast notification 'Application Submitted Successfully! Our HR team will review your profile and reach out.' and reset form state.

positions.title: Site Mechanical Engineer
positions.description: Supervising fabrication, erection of heavy process structures and plant commissioning.

positions.title: Civil Project Manager
positions.description: Leading civil foundation, structural works, and project scheduling for cement/power packages.

positions.title: QA / QC Welding & NDT Engineer
positions.description: Inspection, testing and quality validation for structural steel fabrication and high-pressure piping.

positions.title: EHS Safety Officer
positions.description: Enforcing zero-harm safety standards, conducting safety audits and workforce tool-box trainings.

motion.transition_rules: Specific property transitions only (e.g. transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease). Never use transition: all.

accessibility.contrast_minimums: 4.5:1 for normal body text, 3:1 for large headers and buttons
accessibility.form_labels: All form inputs must have associated <label> elements with matching htmlId and data-testid attributes
accessibility.file_upload: Custom styled upload zones must remain accessible with hidden native input and keyboard-focusable trigger buttons

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. In /app/frontend/src/components/Navbar.jsx: Remove the phone number link from desktop header (line with Phone icon and COMPANY.phone) and replace it with <Link to='/contact' data-testid='header-get-quote-button' className='bg-[#c8a25c] hover:bg-[#d9b877] text-[#0a1a2f] font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider px-5 py-2.5 rounded-sm shadow-md transition-all hover:scale-[1.02]'>GET A QUOTE</Link>. Ensure both logo and footer logo remain untouched.

2. In /app/frontend/src/components/Careers.jsx (or a new dedicated CareersApplicationForm component used in CareersPage.jsx): Remove the old 'Quick apply' card. Replace with the full two-column 'Career Application Form' matching reference: Role (text field), Full Name, Date of Birth, Gender (Select), Phone Number, Email, Highest Qualification, Marital Status (Select), Address (Textarea), Upload Resume, Upload Photo, and centered 'Submit Application' button.
3. Provide interactive 'Apply for this Role' buttons on the Open Positions cards that automatically pre-fill the 'Role' text field and scroll down smoothly to the application form.

4. In /app/backend/server.py: Add FastAPI endpoint @api_router.post('/careers/apply') that accepts JSON/multipart form data (handling file names/base64/uploads if provided), stores the application into MongoDB 'career_applications', logs/handles internal notification with mock fallback for SMTP so submission is resilient, and returns 200 OK.
5. Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., 'header-get-quote-button', 'career-role-input', 'career-fullname-input', 'career-submit-button', etc.).
